# OmniPhysicsElementCollisionFilter

Excludes groups of collision elements of two sources from colliding with each other: one source is a deformable body, the other a deformable body or a rigid. The walker enumerates the type by exact [usd-prim-type](prim.md#columns) and the runtime creates one PxDeformableElementFilter per enabled [prim](glossary.md#prim) whose sources resolve.

- **Type chain:** [`Imageable`](glossary.md#imageable), [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Applicable APIs:** [`CollectionAPI`](CollectionAPI.md), [`GeomInstanceAPI`](GeomInstanceAPI.md), [`GeomInstanceRootAPI`](GeomInstanceRootAPI.md), [`GeomPrototypeAPI`](GeomPrototypeAPI.md), [`PhysicsMaterialAPI`](PhysicsMaterialAPI.md), [`PhysxAutoDeformableAttachmentAPI`](PhysxAutoDeformableAttachmentAPI.md), [`PhysxMaterialAPI`](PhysxMaterialAPI.md), [`PhysxSceneAPI`](PhysxSceneAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI`](PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleClutchAPI`](PhysxVehicleClutchAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI`](PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI`](PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleEngineAPI`](PhysxVehicleEngineAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleGearsAPI`](PhysxVehicleGearsAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI`](PhysxVehicleNonlinearCommandResponseAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleSuspensionAPI`](PhysxVehicleSuspensionAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleTireAPI`](PhysxVehicleTireAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleWheelAPI`](PhysxVehicleWheelAPI.md), [`PrototypeRootAPI`](PrototypeRootAPI.md)
- **Discovery:** by prim_type, probe `omniphysics:filterEnabled`
- **Transform columns:** none, not [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `omniphysics:filterEnabled` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | true | Enabled: the parser defaults to true and the runtime creates the PxDeformableElementFilter. With false the filter object is registered but no [PhysX](glossary.md#physx) filter is made. |
| `omniphysics:src0` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | The prim is dropped silently: the parser needs exactly one target on src0 and on src1 and otherwise emits no filter. One target must resolve to a created deformable body and the other to a deformable body or an Xformable at or below a rigid body; otherwise the runtime logs an error ('has an invalid actor') or creates no filter. |
| `omniphysics:src1` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | Same as omniphysics:src0: without exactly one target the prim is dropped silently. |
| `omniphysics:groupElemCounts0` | uint32 array | none |  | not written |  | Empty: src0 has no groups and is filtered as a whole against every group of src1 (the form a rigid source takes). With omniphysics:groupElemCounts1 absent as well the filter references no specific element, which PxDeformableElementFilter does not support (a checked PhysX build rejects it). |
| `omniphysics:groupElemCounts1` | uint32 array | none |  | not written |  | Empty: src1 has no groups and is filtered as a whole against every group of src0 (the form a rigid source takes). With omniphysics:groupElemCounts0 absent as well the filter references no specific element, which PxDeformableElementFilter does not support (a checked PhysX build rejects it). |
| `omniphysics:groupElemIndices0` | uint32 array | none |  | not written |  | Empty. Valid only while omniphysics:groupElemCounts0 sums to 0 (absent or all zeros); otherwise the runtime warns ('Sum of groupElemCounts is not equal to groupElemIndices size!') and creates no filter. |
| `omniphysics:groupElemIndices1` | uint32 array | none |  | not written |  | Empty. Valid only while omniphysics:groupElemCounts1 sums to 0 (absent or all zeros); otherwise the runtime warns ('Sum of groupElemCounts is not equal to groupElemIndices size!') and creates no filter. |

## Notes

- For a filter generated by PhysxAutoDeformableAttachmentAPI the runtime reads the four group arrays from its in-memory copy of the generated data first.
